reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "NodePool v1 schema: 1 default changed: `spec.disruption`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: NodePool resources with spec.disruption unset will no longer receive the default consolidateAfter value of 0s; disruption behavior for such NodePools will differ from the previous release.

proposed.statement: The default value for spec.disruption in karpenter.sh/v1 NodePool changed from {"consolidateAfter":"0s"} to none, affecting NodePools that do not explicitly set this field.
